sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 6:10

items.sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 6:10:1
items.html: The restriction of the light upward, so that Atzilut could receive … a new light came out: This refers to the light that emerged through the coupling in the Nikvey Einayim, whose matter was explained above. By this light the discernment of Atzilut alone was corrected, that is, the discernment of Nekudim, up to the Tabur of Nekudim; for up to there is the place of the Atzilut that is destined to be after this world. However, nothing of this light reached the place from the Tabur downward of Nekudim, as will be written below.

items.sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 6:10:2
items.html:
A new light, and certainly that light came diminished, although it is from the name SAG. For through the ascent upward to the place of the Nikvey Einayim, which is Hochma and phase one, SAG was diminished from the level of Bina to the level of ZA; therefore the vessels are able to receive it, in the discernment of Atzilut. And know that this new light is the light of the anterior vessels of GAR [first three], and it is the self of the light of GAR of Nekudim. But that new light which was afterwards emanated through the coupling of AB SAG, which descended and broke through the Parsa and shone upon Nekudim, is not the discernment of the self of the light of Nekudim; rather, it is regarded as a discernment of additional light and a discernment of Gadlut [greatness].
And this is what he says: “that by its ascent upward a new light came out, and certainly that light came diminished; although it is from the name SAG itself, the vessels were able to receive it” — that is, the vessels of GAR of Nekudim, as above. And he calls them the world of Atzilut, because they are the roots for the world of Atzilut.
